commits.message: feat: collect every page of a paged endpoint

files.app/pager.py:
def collect(fetch, max_pages: int = 10):
    cursor = None
    seen = []
    pages = 0
    while pages < max_pages:
        items, cursor = fetch(cursor)
        seen.extend(items)
        pages += 1
        if cursor is None:
            return seen
    raise RuntimeError("cursor did not advance after %d pages" % pages)
